name: James McCloud
vampire_desc: An arrogant and pampered Scottish noble, born around 1050 AD. Soft from a life of luxury, surrounded by sycophants.
mortal_self: James McCloud, born 1050 AD in Scotland. A rich noble, pampered by slaves and surrounded by sycophants. Arrogant and soft.

memories.name: Memory 1
memories.description: Your mortal life — broad overview of who you were before the nights began.
experiences: I was born into silk and sycophants in the misty highlands around 1050 AD — surrounded by those who flattered every whim, I grew arrogant in the knowledge that the world would bend or break for me, not the other way round.

characters.name: Elspeth
characters.description: Younger sister. Smarter and kinder than James, she found refuge with the castle's animals — a wounded hawk, a stray hound, any creature in need of care. She loved James in spite of his arrogance; the only soul in that house who ever did.

characters.name: Jack Stewart
characters.description: Young lord from a nearby estate. Matched James line for line — in wealth, in station, in charm. Where James was born to privilege, Jack had earned his standing. Now courts the same girl James loves, turning rivalry into something that cuts deeper than pride.

characters.name: Bran
characters.description: Retired soldier and James's teacher. Grey-bearded, scarred, he drilled into James from the first dawn: kindness is the language of the weak. Paced the training yard before the sun until those words took root — ruthlessness, money, power. The only virtues.
